JSON parse fallback returns {'pt':[raw],'en':[],'es':[]} on malformed LLM output — UI would show 'Sem legendas neste idioma' for en/es. Acceptable given strict system prompt, could retry once with stricter reminder.
No rate limiting on /api/influencer/ai/captions; a spammy influencer could burn LLM tokens. Consider per-user cooldown.
